title: A Novel Approach for the SDIR Epidemic Model on Online Social Networks
summary: Information diffusion can be controlled by restricting or removing links (edges) in online social networks, as well as in real-world networks. To identify the most influential links to remove while minimizing diffusion, previous studies have proposed upper bounds for spreading processes in SIR and SIS models, using supermodularity and weighted matrices to identify critical links in contact networks.
